items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: He had Eddie, you know Lefty Armand, who played in the bass field.

ctx.x: He had Eddie, you know Lefty Armand, who played in the bass field. He could tell you a lot about it. One of his brothers played in that band, whether it was Paulie or Louie, and you had a band, and Kling, old man Kling played the bass fiddle, and Clown Alphys played the cornet. And Lane's Mill in those days was going real fast, you know? And they had their own little, like these big companies have their own little recreation club, and they had like the dance hall, or the hall for entertainment upstairs and they…
I doubt that we do too.
